title: Duujal Les Sanngara
intro: E nder defte Quraan, limre muñal mawnde ina jogori haɓde e ñaawoore nde ɓuuɓnata ɓerɗe ɓurɗe tiiɗde. Huunde fof 6eydaama - jawdi, galle, e cellal. Kono e nder luggiɗnde mette, duwaawu lesɗikiniiɗo jaabaama e no ɓuri miijaade. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude ooɗoo ruuhu mo daartol mum restoraasiyoŋ ina ɓuuɓtoo e nder duuɓi?
clues: Mi jarribaama e ñaawoore tiiɗnde haa nde siftortee e nder duuɓi kala.
Mi majjii kala ko ina haani - jawdi am, ɓiɓɓe am, e cellal am.
Ɓanndu am ina ɓuuɓna ɓuuɓri mettundi, miɗo reentoo yimɓe fof.
E nder tampere am, mi noddii Alla, mbi’mi Seyɗaane memii kam e caɗeele e torla.
Alla jaabii kam, yamiri mi yo mi fiy leydi e koyngal am.
Gila e oon nokku, ɓuuɓol ɓuuɓngol yani, Alla artiri ɓesngu am, softi ɗum en yurmeende.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Ñawu bonngu e waasde ɓesngu e jawdi
trial.answer: Ñawu bonngu e waasde ɓesngu e jawdi

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Ɓiɓɓe e jawdi ngartiraa, ɓeydaama laabi ɗiɗi
Jaɓɓungal kisal e nder ndiyam ceertuɗam
Jibineede ɓiɗɗo gorko e kaawisaaji e nder mawngu
outcome.answer: Ɓiɓɓe e jawdi ngartiraa, ɓeydaama laabi ɗiɗi

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
